8.description:
When you rest inside a settlement, you gain 【SL】 ingredients (see next page).
You may use an action and combine 2 or 3 ingredients to prepare a delicacy (see next page) and choose one option: you apply its effects to yourself or an ally you can see; or you perform a free attack with a weapon you have equipped. This attack deals no damage, but you apply the delicacy's effects to each enemy hit by the attack.
You may carry up to 10 +【SL × 5】(35) ingredients, and they will never spoil until you use them; if you take this Skill during character creation, you begin play with ten ingredients with random tastes.
